description: Computational neonatology and perinatal transition agent simulating newborn cardiopulmonary adaptation, neonatal resuscitation, RDS surfactant kinetics, bilirubin nomograms, GIR fluid balance, sepsis risk, and therapeutic hypothermia in HIE.

inputs.name: gestational_age_weeks
inputs.description: Gestational age at delivery in fractional weeks

inputs.name: apgar_scores
inputs.description: Standardized 1, 5, and 10 minute APGAR score subcomponents

inputs.name: respiratory_metrics
inputs.description: Silverman-Andersen retraction indices and ventilator parameters

inputs.name: blood_gas
inputs.description: Arterial or capillary blood gas values (pH, pCO2, pO2, HCO3, Base Excess, Lactate)

inputs.name: bilirubin_panel
inputs.description: Total/direct serum bilirubin with postnatal age and neurotoxicity risk factors

inputs.name: maternal_perinatal_data
inputs.description: GBS status, ROM hours, intrapartum fever, and antibiotic prophylaxis

inputs.name: hemodynamic_pda_echo
inputs.description: Echocardiographic patent ductus arteriosus metrics and shunt directions

outputs.name: apgar_evaluation
outputs.description: Resuscitation response, transition scoring, and asphyxia risk categorization

outputs.name: respiratory_plan
outputs.description: RDS grading, Oxygenation Index (OI), surfactant indications, and CPAP/ventilator targets

outputs.name: phototherapy_decision
outputs.description: AAP 2022 hour-specific phototherapy and exchange transfusion recommendations

outputs.name: fluid_metabolic_plan
outputs.description: Total fluid rate (mL/kg/d), Glucose Infusion Rate (mg/kg/min), and electrolyte targets

outputs.name: eos_sepsis_stratification
outputs.description: Early-onset sepsis risk per 1,000 live births and antimicrobial recommendations

outputs.name: hie_cooling_protocol
outputs.description: Sarnat staging, therapeutic hypothermia eligibility, and cooling/rewarming timeline

outputs.name: nec_stage_assessment
outputs.description: Modified Bell staging for necrotizing enterocolitis and clinical management pathway
